description: Get the append-only archive of Ed25519-signed data receipts: every value signed for a series within the rolling window (current + previous signing year), revisions retained, each entry carrying its claim, claimHash, signature, and keyId. Call with no series for the catalogue plus the keyId→publicKey map and the permanent yearly ledger URLs. Same engine as /api/receipts. Try: {}

series.description: Series key, slug, title, or approved alias; omit for the catalogue.

name: get_receipts
